During a '''mission''' to [[Bpfassh]], an attempt was made to capture [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her unborn twins for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Let me guess. Mon Mothma wants me to go to Bpfassh and assure them that the New Republic can protect them.|Leia, to Han Solo|<ref name="Heir to the Empire 2">[[Heir to the Empire 2|''Heir to the Empire'' 2]]</ref>}}
After [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Hit-and-hype raiding|hit-and-fade]] [[Attack on Bpfassh|attack]] on [[Bpfassh]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] wanted [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] to go on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] mission to [[Bpfassh]] in order to assure its people that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] could still protect them. Organa Solo then departed [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] along with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], escorted by a twenty-ship convoy and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

==Mission==
{{Quote|I think we're in trouble.''"<br />"''I think you're right.|Wedge Antilles and Han Solo|<ref name="Heir to the Empire 2" />}}
[[File:Bpfassh_surface.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Han Solo, Leia Organa Solo and Wedge Antilles inspect a crater after a planetary bombardment on Bpfassh.]]

While inspecting the crater of a [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|planetary bombardment]] on Bpfassh, Han Solo, Leia Organa Solo and Wedge Antilles were ambushed by a [[Team Four (Noghri)|team]] of [[Noghri Death Commando]]s.

[[Millennium Falcon (fake)|What seemed to be]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] flown by Chewbacca quickly showed up to rescue them, but Organa Solo, who had been training as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with her [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|brother]], sensed something wrong. Solo realized that the ship was a double of the ''Millennium Falcon'', and he used his wife's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to disable it and send up a plume of [[korfaise]] coolant gas that quickly attracted the real ''Millennium Falcon'' and Rogue Squadron to drive off the would-be captors.
